title: Edward Dube
vital_facts: Baptized August 1984; Aaronic Priestood followed by Melchizedek Priesthood
Missionary to South Africa Johannesbrg Mission 1986-1987
Married Naume Keresia Salazini 1989; Sealed 1992 Johannesburg South Africa Temple; four children
Diploma in Education from Zimbabwe D. E. College; studied Entrepeneurship at the University of South Africa.
Employment: Church Educational System for 17 years.
Branch President, District President, Stake President, Counselor in Mission Presidency, Area Seventy.
President of Zimbabwe Harare Mission from 2009 to 2012;
